data.name: Confident Defense
data.description: When wearing light or no armor and not using a shield, you add 1 point of your Charisma bonus (if any) per paladin level to your Dexterity bonus to your Armor Class; you lose this bonus whenever you are denied your Dexterity bonus.  This ability is currently increasing your effective dexterity modifier to AC by %1.|ConfidentDefenseGain
